newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TENNIS-SICK ULIHRACH RETIRES IN FIRST ROUND AT ECC.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SICK ULIHRACH RETIRES IN FIRST ROUND AT ECC.

text.p: Czech Bohdan Ulihrach retired ill after just 26 minutes of his first round match against Belgian qualifier Dick Norman at the European Community tennis championship on Monday.
"He has the flu, he's got fever," an ATP spokeswoman said.
Ulihrach, number 39 in the ATP rankings, was trailing 5-2 when he surrendered the match to Norman, who is ranked nearly 200 places higher at 234.

Norman had a brief spell of glory in 1995 when he reached round 16 at Wimbledon, but he has since steadily slipped down the rankings and failed to survive the first round in most of the tournaments he played last year.
Norman now faces fifth seed Felix Mantilla of Spain.
